import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

DT = torch.float16


class Model(nn.Module):
    # Attention-output-style projection with fused epilogue:
    #   y = x + gamma * gelu(x @ W^T + b)
    # x: [B, S, H] fp16, W: [H, H], b/gamma: [H]   (H = 4096, B*S = 8192 tokens)
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.hidden = 4096
        device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
        w = torch.randn(self.hidden, self.hidden, generator=g) * 0.02
        b = torch.randn(self.hidden, generator=g) * 0.02
        gamma = 0.5 + 0.25 * torch.rand(self.hidden, generator=g)
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(w.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.bias = nn.Parameter(b.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.gamma = nn.Parameter(gamma.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        h = F.linear(x, self.weight, self.bias)      # GEMM + bias
        h = F.gelu(h, approximate="tanh")            # activation
        return x + self.gamma * h                    # per-channel scale + residual


def get_inputs():
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1)
    x = torch.randn(16, 512, 4096, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=device, dtype=DT)]

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn

DT = torch.float16

# Grouped-query attention core, Llama-3-8B-style head config:
#   32 query heads, 8 key/value heads (4 query heads share each KV head), head_dim 128.
# Input is the packed QKV activation [B, S, (Hq + 2*Hkv) * D] as produced by a fused QKV
# projection; output is [B, S, Hq * D] = softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(D)) V with no mask.
BATCH = 4
SEQ = 2048
N_Q_HEADS = 32
N_KV_HEADS = 8
HEAD_DIM = 128


class Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.n_q = N_Q_HEADS
        self.n_kv = N_KV_HEADS
        self.d = HEAD_DIM
        self.groups = self.n_q // self.n_kv  # query heads per kv head
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.d)

    def forward(self, x):
        # x: [B, S, (n_q + 2*n_kv) * d], packed as [ q | k | v ] along the last dim
        B, S, _ = x.shape
        q_end = self.n_q * self.d
        k_end = q_end + self.n_kv * self.d

        q = x[:, :, :q_end].reshape(B, S, self.n_q, self.d).transpose(1, 2)        # [B, Hq,  S, d]
        k = x[:, :, q_end:k_end].reshape(B, S, self.n_kv, self.d).transpose(1, 2)  # [B, Hkv, S, d]
        v = x[:, :, k_end:].reshape(B, S, self.n_kv, self.d).transpose(1, 2)       # [B, Hkv, S, d]

        # GQA: kv head j serves query heads [j*groups, (j+1)*groups)
        k = k.repeat_interleave(self.groups, dim=1)                                 # [B, Hq, S, d]
        v = v.repeat_interleave(self.groups, dim=1)                                 # [B, Hq, S, d]

        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)).float() * self.scale         # [B, Hq, S, S] fp32
        probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1).to(self.dt)                           # [B, Hq, S, S] fp16
        out = torch.matmul(probs, v)                                                # [B, Hq, S, d]
        return out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, self.n_q * self.d)                 # [B, S, Hq*d]


def get_inputs():
    device = "cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu"
    g = torch.Generator(device=device).manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(
        BATCH, SEQ, (N_Q_HEADS + 2 * N_KV_HEADS) * HEAD_DIM,
        device=device, dtype=torch.float32, generator=g,
    )
    return [x.to(DT)]

N_HEADS = 16
HEAD_DIM = D_MODEL // N_HEADS  # 64


class Model(nn.Module):
    """Causal multi-head self-attention layer (GPT-style).

    x [B, S, D] -> fused QKV projection -> per-head softmax(mask(QK^T / sqrt(d))) V
    -> merge heads -> output projection. Returns [B, S, D] in DT.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(0)
        std = 1.0 / math.sqrt(D_MODEL)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(3 * D_MODEL, D_MODEL, generator=g) * std
        w_out = torch.randn(D_MODEL, D_MODEL, generator=g) * std
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_out = nn.Parameter(w_out.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        causal_mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(SEQ, SEQ, dtype=torch.bool), diagonal=1)
        self.register_buffer("causal_mask", causal_mask.to(device), persistent=False)
        self.n_heads = N_HEADS
        self.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(HEAD_DIM)  # 0.125, exact in fp16

    def forward(self, x):
        B, S, D = x.shape
        qkv = torch.matmul(x, self.w_qkv.t())                        # [B, S, 3D]
        qkv = qkv.view(B, S, 3, self.n_heads, self.head_dim)
        q, k, v = qkv.unbind(dim=2)                                   # [B, S, H, d]
        q = q.transpose(1, 2)                                         # [B, H, S, d]
        k = k.transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.transpose(1, 2)
        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale    # [B, H, S, S]
        scores = scores.masked_fill(self.causal_mask[:S, :S], float("-inf"))
        attn = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1)                          # fp32 accumulate, fp16 out
        out = torch.matmul(attn, v)                                   # [B, H, S, d]
        out = out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, D)                    # [B, S, D]

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

        out = LN3( h2 * layerscale + x )

        self.b1 = p(0.5 * torch.randn(self.d, generator=g))
        self.b2 = p(0.5 * torch.randn(self.d, generator=g))

        q, k, v = torch.split(x, [hq * d, hkv * d, hkv * d], dim=-1)

        q = q.view(b, s, self.n_q, self.d).transpose(1, 2)    # [B, Hq,  S, D]

        # expand KV heads to match Q heads (each KV head serves `groups` consecutive Q heads)
        k = k.repeat_interleave(self.groups, dim=1)           # [B, Hq, S, D]
        v = v.repeat_interleave(self.groups, dim=1)           # [B, Hq, S, D]

        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale   # [B, Hq, S, S]
        attn = torch.softmax(scores.float(), dim=-1).to(self.dt)     # fp32 softmax, no mask
        out = torch.matmul(attn, v)                                   # [B, Hq, S, D]
        return out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, s, self.n_q * self.d)  # [B, S, Hq*D]

    x = torch.randn(
        BATCH, SEQ, (N_Q_HEADS + 2 * N_KV_HEADS) * HEAD_DIM,

    into the weights / epilogue), and (b) fuse bias + tanh-GELU + residual read/add into the
    GEMM epilogue, while still matching cuBLAS fp16 tensor-core throughput on M=16384, N=K=4096.

        beta = 0.1 * torch.randn(H, generator=g, device=device, dtype=torch.float32)

        super().__init__()
        torch.manual_seed(0)
        self.S, self.E, self.H = 2048, 1024, 16
        self.D = self.E // self.H
        self.scale = 1.0 / (self.D ** 0.5)

        self.proj = nn.Linear(self.E, self.E, bias=True)
        for lin in (self.qkv, self.proj):
            nn.init.normal_(lin.weight, mean=0.0, std=0.02)
            nn.init.normal_(lin.bias, mean=0.0, std=0.02)
        self.to(device=device, dtype=dt)

# Realistic mid-size decoder shapes (GPT-2-medium width, 4k context)
BATCH = 4
SEQ_LEN = 4096
N_EMBD = 1024
N_HEAD = 16


class Model(nn.Module):
    """
    Causal multi-head self-attention block written the naive way:
      fused QKV projection -> per-head QK^T * (1/sqrt(d)) -> causal mask (-inf)
      -> softmax (fp32) -> cast -> @ V -> merge heads -> output projection.
    The [B, H, T, T] score matrix is fully materialized in the reference.
    """

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.n_head = N_HEAD
        self.head_dim = N_EMBD // N_HEAD
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(self.head_dim)

        g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(1234)
        w_qkv = torch.randn(3 * N_EMBD, N_EMBD, generator=g) / math.sqrt(N_EMBD)
        w_out = torch.randn(N_EMBD, N_EMBD, generator=g) / math.sqrt(N_EMBD)
        self.w_qkv = nn.Parameter(w_qkv.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)
        self.w_out = nn.Parameter(w_out.to(device=device, dtype=dt), requires_grad=False)

        # True above the diagonal == positions that must be masked out
        neg_mask = torch.triu(torch.ones(SEQ_LEN, SEQ_LEN, dtype=torch.bool, device=device), diagonal=1)
        self.register_buffer("neg_mask", neg_mask.view(1, 1, SEQ_LEN, SEQ_LEN), persistent=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, T, C = x.shape
        qkv = F.linear(x, self.w_qkv)                                   # [B, T, 3C]
        q, k, v = qkv.split(C, dim=2)
        q = q.view(B, T, self.n_head, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)    # [B, H, T, D]
        k = k.view(B, T, self.n_head, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = v.view(B, T, self.n_head, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)

        att = (q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)) * self.scale                    # [B, H, T, T]
        att = att.masked_fill(self.neg_mask[:, :, :T, :T], float("-inf"))
        att = torch.softmax(att, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(q.dtype)
        y = att @ v                                                     # [B, H, T, D]
        y = y.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(B, T, C)                # [B, T, C]
        return F.linear(y, self.w_out)

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    g = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(42)
    x = torch.randn(BATCH, SEQ_LEN, N_EMBD, generator=g)
    return [x.to(device=device, dtype=DT)]

    """Multi-head scaled-dot-product attention core: softmax(Q K^T / sqrt(d)) V.

    No mask, no dropout.  Input x is the fused QKV activation tensor
    [B, S, 3*H*D] (exactly what a fused QKV linear projection produces);
    output is the attention result with heads merged back: [B, S, H*D].

        self.dt = dt
        self.num_heads = HEADS

        k = k.transpose(1, 2)                                        # [B, H, S, D]

        out = torch.matmul(probs, v)                                 # [B, H, S, D]
        return out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, S, H * D)              # [B, S, H*D]

    and the residual is the raw (un-normalized) input, so the whole chain must stay consistent.

        super().__init__()
        device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        g = torch.Generator().manual_seed(1234)

        self.ln = nn.LayerNorm(HIDDEN, eps=1e-5)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(HIDDEN, HIDDEN, bias=True)

        bound = 1.0 / (HIDDEN ** 0.5)
        with torch.no_grad():
            self.ln.weight.copy_(1.0 + 0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g))
            self.ln.bias.copy_(0.1 * torch.randn(HIDDEN, generator=g))
            self.proj.weight.copy_(torch.empty(HIDDEN, HIDDEN).uniform_(-bound, bound, generator=g))
            self.proj.bias.copy_(torch.empty(HIDDEN).uniform_(-bound, bound, generator=g))

        for p in self.parameters():
            p.requires_grad_(False)

        h = self.ln(x)                      # LayerNorm over HIDDEN (fp32 internal stats, fp16 out)
        h = self.proj(h)                    # matmul + bias

DT = torch.float16

# Llama-3-8B style grouped-query attention shapes
BATCH = 4

N_KV_HEADS = 8
HEAD_DIM = 128


class Model(nn.Module):
    """GQA attention core. x = packed [q | k | v] projections, shape [B, S, (H + 2*Hkv)*d].
    Q has N_HEADS heads, K/V have N_KV_HEADS heads; each KV head is shared by
    N_HEADS // N_KV_HEADS consecutive Q heads. Full (non-causal) softmax(QK^T/sqrt(d))V.
    Returns [B, S, H*d] in fp16."""

    def __init__(self, dt=DT):
        super().__init__()
        self.dt = dt
        self.n_heads = N_HEADS
        self.n_kv_heads = N_KV_HEADS
        self.head_dim = HEAD_DIM
        self.n_rep = N_HEADS // N_KV_HEADS
        self.scale = 1.0 / math.sqrt(HEAD_DIM)

    def forward(self, x):
        bsz, seqlen, _ = x.shape
        H, Hkv, d, G = self.n_heads, self.n_kv_heads, self.head_dim, self.n_rep

        q, k, v = torch.split(x, [H * d, Hkv * d, Hkv * d], dim=-1)
        q = q.reshape(bsz, seqlen, H, d).transpose(1, 2)        # [B, H,   S, d]
        k = k.reshape(bsz, seqlen, Hkv, d).transpose(1, 2)      # [B, Hkv, S, d]
        v = v.reshape(bsz, seqlen, Hkv, d).transpose(1, 2)      # [B, Hkv, S, d]

        # repeat_kv: kv head j serves q heads [j*G, (j+1)*G)
        k = k[:, :, None, :, :].expand(bsz, Hkv, G, seqlen, d).reshape(bsz, H, seqlen, d)
        v = v[:, :, None, :, :].expand(bsz, Hkv, G, seqlen, d).reshape(bsz, H, seqlen, d)

        scores = torch.matmul(q * self.scale, k.transpose(-1, -2))          # [B, H, S, S] fp16
        probs = torch.softmax(scores, dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).to(self.dt)
        out = torch.matmul(probs, v)                                        # [B, H, S, d]
        return out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(bsz, seqlen, H * d)


def get_inputs():
    g = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(0)
    x = torch.randn(
        BATCH, SEQ, (N_HEADS + 2 * N_KV_HEADS) * HEAD_DIM,
        generator=g, device="cuda", dtype=DT,
    )
    return [x]
